qualityScope: Existing cooked geometric-error metric, conservative own refinement envelope intersecting the frustum; no HZB exclusion. DAG coverage checked independently.
timingScope: Synchronous offscreen GPUDriven + MaterialResolve, without presentation blit or timed-frame image/debug readback. Checkpoint verification and initialization excluded; not editor presentation FPS.
notes: Near legacy sampled every five seconds; fixed current samples every half second initially. Do not infer a cold convergence speedup from their first observed zero.
Legacy roaming duration is 60 seconds and current roaming duration 180 seconds. Compare uploads at the matching 55-second checkpoint, not unequal-duration timing percentiles.
The 1 GiB page pool remains allocated. Reduced used residency does not imply equal physical VRAM savings.
64 MiB pressure passes budget and complete fallback, but does not meet the 1.5 px quality target.
Changes after these performance runs only extend the pixel guard to portrait viewports; 1920x1080 uses the identical guard. Final regressions exercise the updated shader.
